chunks.title: Dynamic Programming Notes
chunks.text: Dynamic programming solves problems by breaking them into overlapping subproblems. Memoization stores results in a table so each subproblem is solved only once.

chunks.title: Graph Algorithms
chunks.text: Dijkstra algorithm finds the shortest path in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights using a priority queue.

chunks.title: Binary Tree Traversal
chunks.text: Inorder traversal visits left subtree, root node, then right subtree. Preorder visits root first.

chunks.title: Search Algorithms PDF
chunks.text: Binary Search runs in O(log n) time by halving the search space.

chunks.title: Two Pointer Notes
chunks.text: The two-pointer technique maintains two indices moving towards each other to find pairs in sorted arrays.
